items.label: Auto On/Off Landscape Lighting
items.value: Built-in sensitive dusk to dawn sensor, the outdoor landscape lights automatically turn on at night and turn off during the day. 450LM 5W led spotlight add brilliance to the appearance of your home and save money.(!!!Note: Because the photocell sensor is in the head of the lamp, the orientation of the head will affect its sensing of brightness, and it will go out when it senses that the surroundings are bright enough.)

items.label: Upgrade 9.84 FT Cord
items.value: LOHAS outdoor spotlight received UL listed and offer one year warranty, 3m/9.84Ft cord length with US standard plug. Superior cord length to other spotlights on the market, no more extension cords.

items.label: IP66 Waterproof Spotlight
items.value: LOHAS yard patio path spotlights have excellent performance under rainy and snowy weather. Greatly improve the stability and long-term use of outdoor lighting. 360⁰ rotatable and 120 ⁰ beam angle of spotlights perfect for lighting up the flags, trees, patio, yard, garden, driveway.

items.label: Decorate Your Yard
items.value: 3000K warm white landscape spotlights with photocell sensor are soft and not dazzling, creating a quiet and comfortable atmosphere for your courtyard, garden trails. Nice light to showcase your flowers and trees at night.

items.label: Easy Installation
items.value: Find a proper outdoor ready water-proof power outlet, plug in and you are ready to go. Commonly used for highlighting indoor plants, illuminating lawn and garden landscaping, lighting up pathway or indoor and outdoor signage. Also can be mounted on walls and decks by using the disc base attachment.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: 9.84 FT(3M) Cord with US 3-Plug, Auto On/Off, Dusk to Dawn Sensor, Energy Efficient, Waterproof
